item.title: Ex-Dodger Yasiel Puig convicted of federal charges in sports gambling case
item.description: Yasiel Puig was convicted of obstruction of justice and making false statements to federal investigators. He is due for sentencing in May.

item.title: Trump says he "didn't see" image depicting Obamas as apes in social media post
item.description: President Trump late Friday addressed a video posted to his social media account that included a racist depiction of Barack and Michelle Obama as apes, telling reporters he didn't see the part that showed the former president and first lady.

item.title: White House removes Trump post with racist footage of Obamas hours after defending it
item.description: The footage is included in a video that promotes false claims that the 2020 presidential election was rigged against Mr. Trump.

item.title: Republicans condemn Trump's racist video portraying the Obamas as apes
item.description: The criticism continued even after the White House removed the video after the initial backlash.

item.title: Pentagon says it's cutting ties with "woke" Harvard
item.description: The Pentagon says it will cut ties with Harvard University, ending graduate-level military training, fellowship and certificate programs.

item.title: Appeals court endorses Trump policy of denying bond hearings to many ICE detainees
item.description: A federal appeals court on Friday endorsed the Trump administration's policy of holding broad groups of immigration detainees without access to bond hearings, a major legal victory for President Trump.
